brief.summary: Intellectual, slightly odd colour and print: a painterly or geometric print on an A-line skirt, a chunky colour-blocked knit, a boxy coat in an unexpected shade, worn with a flat sculptural shoe. Proportions are deliberately off — cropped and wide, long and boxy — and the joy is in the clash that works.
signatures: bold geometric or painterly print midi skirt
colour-blocked chunky knit or striped mohair cardigan
boxy cocoon coat in a strong colour
flat sculptural shoe — platform sandal, fussbett, square-toe mary jane
the Trunk bag or a colour-blocked tote
silhouettes: shift dress with a flat shoe
